facts.fact: WHO's Regional Office for Africa says its AI-based Preparedness Data Exchange (PDX) platform is now in use in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, giving national teams epidemic intelligence and early-warning signals during the Ebola response.

systems.platform: WHO AFRO AI platform linked to a regional platform of 47 member states
